articles.title: Agent State in the Tmux Status Line
articles.summary: Agent state in the Tmux status line is a crucial aspect of managing multiple agent sessions side by side in tmux windows. The agent status is typically displayed in a sidebar pane and a status-line segment, allowing developers to quickly identify which window is still working, which is stuck waiting on a decision, and which finished. The Herdr agent-first terminal multiplexer is a popular solution that classifies sessions as working, blocked, done, or idle and shows them in a sidebar, but it has two objections: it introduces a separate surface to context-switch into for information that belongs next to the windows it describes, and it replaces tmux rather than fitting the existing habit of glancing at a status line. A new solution, agenmux, keeps tmux and answers the second objection, rendering agent state into a sidebar pane and a status-line segment, and writes the marker onto the window entries themselves.
